name: Executor Zygand
summary: In Brill, Executor Zygand directs the Forsaken defenses across central Tirisfal Glades. He reports to the Undercity's high command and coordinates the fight against Scarlet Crusade forces pressing into Forsaken lands.

sections.title: Command in Brill
sections.body: After the Forsaken awakened in Deathknell, Executor Zygand took charge of regional defenses from Brill. Officers such as Executor Arren and field sentries such as Deathguard Linnea report to him. Zygand gathers scouts' reports and sends able recruits to guard Lordaeron's borders against encroachment.

sections.title: The War on the Crusade
sections.body: The Scarlet Crusade's presence across Tirisfal Glades keeps Executor Zygand busy. He sends agents against Crusader scouts, encampments, and forward bases. That work keeps the zealots from gathering enough strength to threaten the approaches to the Undercity.

faq.answer: Executor Zygand is a senior Forsaken officer based in Brill, Tirisfal Glades. He commands local Deathguard garrisons, receives reports from lower-ranking officers, and directs campaigns against local threats.

faq.q: Where can I find Executor Zygand?
faq.answer: You can find Executor Zygand inside or near Brill's main town hall. Brill is the central Forsaken settlement in Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Zygand's main goal in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand directs the regional war against the Scarlet Crusade. He tracks the zealots across Tirisfal and orders their encampments and leadership dismantled before they can march on the Undercity.
Executor Arren and field sentries such as Deathguard Linnea report to Executor Zygand. Arren directs initial recruits in Deathknell, while Linnea patrols Tirisfal Glades' main crossroads.

faq.q: Does Executor Zygand handle rogue undead threats?
faq.answer: Yes. Executor Zygand also issues regional bounties against feral undead and dangerous rogue scavengers that endanger travel through the glades. They include the corpse-stealing gnoll Maggot Eye.

faq.q: What rank does an 'Executor' hold among the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Among the Forsaken, an Executor holds authority as a regional governor and military commander. Executors manage settlements, command local Deathguard units, and enforce Queen Sylvanas's rule across Lordaeron's contested regions.

angles.text: As a Forsaken venturing out of Deathknell, you meet Executor Zygand, who represents the Undercity's wider military authority. He brings new citizens into active service against their bitterest enemies.
As a traveler from Kalimdor in Tirisfal Glades, you can see in Zygand the disciplined military leadership guiding the Forsaken's struggle to secure Lordaeron.
